comment: Experimental Bitters-inspired multi-effect: distortion, sine phaser, and one of decimation, bitcrushing, pitch vibrato or ring modulation. Two chain orders. Independent implementation, not an exact emulation.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: Four named regions: Decim, Crush, FM, Ring.

params.name: Amount
params.comment: Selected processor strength; zero bypasses it.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: Gain-compensated cubic distortion; zero bypasses it.

params.name: Phase
params.comment: Six-stage sine-swept phaser, up to 20 Hz; zero bypasses it.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Stereo dry to mono processed wet; exact dry at zero.
